description: SIMPLE SIDEWAYS TEST — every pass sprays sideways, no vertical. Forces the ability factor to 0 (so every player kicks at the error ceiling), sets the HORIZONTAL error ceiling to 90deg and the VERTICAL ceiling to 0.5deg. Result: essentially every kick deviates left/right, averaging ~36deg and up to 90deg, with almost no up/down. NOT realistic — a visibility test to confirm the sideways channel works. Remove with: exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/test-sideways.json

patches.name: TEST: accuracy factor forced 0 (nobody kicks straight)
TEST: VERTICAL error ceiling -> 0.5 deg (no up/down)
